title: Executive MBA vs. Full-Time MBA Decision Engine
description: 10-year NPV comparison of three paths: EMBA (keep working), Full-Time MBA (2-year leave), and No MBA. Models employer sponsorship, 2-year forgone salary, career pivot feasibility by goal type, salary lift timing, and year-by-year break-even.
data_vintage: Zero — pure NPV math on user-supplied inputs
